question: With the Step B SNpp45 coxa forward-limit encoder delivering input, does coxa motor-neuron activity become sensitive to posture (held vs released), and does it shift in the published CxHP8 reflex direction?
encoder: malecns_backend.embodiment.hair_plate_encoder (Step B, ENCODER_READY; tuning from docs/evidence/hair-plate-encoder-v1/run/result.json), used as-is including the standing-pose saturation in LF/RF/LH and 68.5 Hz in RH

arms.A: all 42 position servos keep the original assisted policy
arms.R: the same 22 baseline-only rows as the V1.2 R arms (assistance_native.partition selection) have actuator_gainprm and actuator_biasprm zeroed once, after recorded physics state 5005 (assistance_native.write_rows); first affected state 5006
arms.ON: hair-plate encoder rates delivered from t = 0
arms.OFF: identical encoder, schedule and RNG draws, hair-plate delivery withheld at the CNS boundary
arms.common: live-v3 kernel, 20 motor channels, tibia proprioception, seed 1, 2 s (20000 physics / 4000 neural transitions), no push, no retries, fresh process per arm

input_boundary: instance-local adapter modeled on live.tactile_boundary: one common external schedule = 392 tibia proprioceptive + 52 SNpp45 neurons; same Bernoulli equation; identical uniforms in all arms; hair-plate drive set each neural tick from current physics and cleared after the tick

integrity.I1_complete: all four arms COMPLETE with 20001 states and 4000 neural ticks
integrity.I2_common_rng: identical external schedule and identical per-tick uniform digests in all arms
integrity.I3_prefix: A_OFF and R_OFF qpos identical for states 0..5005 and first differ at a state >= 5006; same for A_ON vs R_ON
integrity.I4_intervention: R arms record exactly one row-zeroing event at state 5005 whose model record equals the declared neutral record; A arms record none
integrity.I5_delivery: OFF arms deliver zero hair-plate events; ON arms deliver > 0
integrity.rule: any integrity failure -> INCONCLUSIVE_INTEGRITY; no behavioral label is assigned

readouts.window: neural ticks with time in (520, 2000] ms; physics states 5201..20000
readouts.coxa_mn_rate: spikes of all bodymap coxa, coxa_abduct and coxa_twist leg MN neurons (union, all legs) / neurons / window seconds
readouts.posterior_rate: same for Pleural remotor/abductor + Sternal posterior rotator MN neurons
readouts.anterior_rate: same for Tergopleural/Pleural promotor + Sternal anterior rotator MN neurons
readouts.tilt: angle between world up and thorax/root body z from qpos[3:7]; rollover = tilt > 90 deg

questions.Q1_posture_sensitivity: dOFF = |coxa_mn_rate(A_OFF) - coxa_mn_rate(R_OFF)|, dON = same for ON. POSTURE_SENSITIVE if dON >= 2 * dOFF and dON >= 0.5 Hz; else NOT_POSTURE_SENSITIVE
questions.Q2_reflex_direction: in A arms: dPost = posterior_rate(A_ON) - posterior_rate(A_OFF), dAnt = same for anterior. REFLEX_DIRECTION_CONSISTENT if dPost > 0 and dPost > dAnt; else NOT_CONSISTENT
questions.descriptive: per-leg coxa MN rates, hair-plate delivered events, tilt mean/peak and rollover samples per arm, R_ON vs R_OFF tilt difference, first physical divergence ON vs OFF

interpretation_limits: One seed, assisted position control in A arms; not independent balance or gait.
Encoder tuning is modeled; the standing pose saturates it in four legs, so A_ON tests mostly a constant limit signal.
A label describes this model run; it is not biological validation of CxHP8 function.
evidence: per-arm raw gz kept local (hashes in the report); the report, receipts and console logs are committed
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed.
